properties.site-address: Oxgate Farm Works, Coles Green Road, NW2 7EY
properties.notes: Demolition of industrial buildings (Use class B2/B8) and erection of a three storey building providing a mixed use development comprising offices (Use class B1a) on the ground level and 9 self-contained flats (2 x 2bed, 5 x 2bed and 2 x 3bed) on the first and second floors, with associated car and cycle parking spaces, bin stores, landscaping and amenity space (as amended) and subject to a Deed of Agreement dated 22 February 2017 under Section 106 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended.
